title: Tour
description: A popup component for guiding users through a product.
whenToUse: Use when you want to guide users through a product.

examples.name: Basic
Non-modal
examples.description: Use `mask={false}` to make Tour non-modal. At the meantime it is recommended to use with `type="primary"` to emphasize the guide itself.

examples.name: Placement
examples.description: Change the placement of the guide relative to the target, there are 12 placements available. When `target={null}` the guide will show in the center.

props.name: Tour

parts.name: root
parts.description: Tour root container with absolute positioning, z-index control, max width, visibility, arrow background color variable, theme styles and other container styles

parts.name: cover
parts.description: Card cover area with text center alignment, padding, image width and other image display styles

parts.name: close
parts.description: Close button element with absolute positioning, size, color, hover state and other interactive feedback styles

parts.name: section
parts.description: Card main content area with text alignment, border radius, box shadow, relative positioning, background color, border, background clip and other card styles

parts.name: footer
parts.description: Card bottom action area with padding, text right alignment, border radius, flex layout and other bottom container styles

parts.name: actions
parts.description: Action button group container with left auto margin, button spacing and other button group layout styles

parts.name: indicator
parts.description: Single indicator element with width/height size, inline-block display, border radius, background color, right margin, active state and other dot styles

parts.name: indicators
parts.description: Indicator group container with inline-block display and other indicator container styles

parts.name: header
parts.description: Card header area with padding, width calculation, word break and other header container styles

parts.name: title
parts.description: Guide title text with font weight and other title text styles

parts.name: description
parts.description: Guide description text with padding, word wrap and other description text styles

parts.name: mask
parts.description: Mask layer element with fixed positioning, full screen coverage, z-index, pointer events, transition animation and other mask styles
